title: The Many Faces of the Chiricahua Mountains
credit: "The Many Faces of the Chiricahua Mountains" by Friends of Cave Creek Canyon (youtube.com/watch?v=SGEI69bBs6o), licensed CC BY
desc: A compilation of views of the eastern flank of the Chiricahua Mountains as seen from the San Simon Valley over time.  Always in flux the scene changes by the hour, day, and season.  These images are just a sampling of the landscape views in this isolated corner of Arizona.  And just behind Portal Peak is the fabled Cave Creek Canyon.
